title: Wasteland
build: Electronic Arts disk release, two double-sided disks as four G64 side images; play copies made with the game's own Copy utility

records.c: Picture 59's header, read by start_picture ($0586): its area, columns 1 to 11 and pixel rows 16 to 99 (inside the picture window, which picture_window_open $12CF clears from pixel row 16 to 111); then five words counted from the picture's start ($E000, where load_portrait $2631 unpacks it for a picture number with bit 7 set, as show_picture_e000 $041C asks): the base frame at +$0087, channel 0's script at +$000E, channel 1's script at +$0042, channel 2's script at +$0058 and channel 3's script at +$006B.

Channel 0's script, read by animate_picture_tick ($05F4-$0646): 17 entries of a delay byte and a frame word counted from the picture's start, then the $FF that sends the channel back to its first entry. Each entry XORs its frame onto the picture, then the channel waits that many steps: frame 1 then 20, frame 2 then 5, frame 3 then 5, frame 4 then 6, frame 5 then 3, frame 6 then 3, frame 7 then 5, frame 8 then 15, frame 9 then 5, frame 10 then 5, frame 11 then 6, frame 12 then 7, frame 13 then 7, frame 14 then 7, frame 15 then 6, frame 16 then 5, frame 17 then 4. One pass takes 114 steps.

Channel 1's script, read by animate_picture_tick ($05F4-$0646): 7 entries of a delay byte and a frame word counted from the picture's start, then the $FF that sends the channel back to its first entry. Each entry XORs its frame onto the picture, then the channel waits that many steps: frame 18 then 5, frame 19 then 6, frame 20 then 6, frame 21 then 7, frame 22 then 10, frame 23 then 30, frame 24 then 27. One pass takes 91 steps.

Channel 3's script, read by animate_picture_tick ($05F4-$0646): 9 entries of a delay byte and a frame word counted from the picture's start, then the $FF that sends the channel back to its first entry. Each entry XORs its frame onto the picture, then the channel waits that many steps: frame 18 then 1, frame 30 then 1, frame 31 then 2, frame 32 then 2, frame 33 then 2, frame 34 then 2, frame 35 then 3, frame 36 then 3, frame 37 then 1. One pass takes 17 steps.

Picture 59's base frame, which start_picture draws by storing (draw_frame_store $064E): a run count of 0 to start, then one block from column 1, pixel row 16, with $06 as its escape byte. Its bytes go down each column and on to the top of the next until the area is full: 924 bitmap bytes, written with 24 runs (the escape byte, then a count and a value).
